SELECT c.relname,c.reltuples,c.relpages,s.n_live_tup,s.n_dead_tup,s.last_analyze::text,s.last_autoanalyze::text,s.n_mod_since_analyze,s.analyze_count,s.autoanalyze_count FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_stat_all_tables s ON s.relid=c.oid WHERE s.schemaname='public' AND c.relname IN ('anchors','graph_types') ORDER BY c.relname
SELECT set_config('statement_timeout', $1, true)
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE

SELECT DISTINCT "_t0"."arch_type" AS "arch_type", "_t0"."arch_module" AS "arch_module" FROM "anchors" AS "_t0" WHERE ("_t0"."kind" = CAST($1 AS text)) ORDER BY "_t0"."arch_type" ASC, "_t0"."arch_module" ASC
COMMIT
SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id = $1
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

SELECT schemaname,tablename,attname,null_frac,avg_width,n_distinct,correlation,most_common_vals::text,most_common_freqs::text,histogram_bounds::text FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('anchors','graph_types') ORDER BY tablename,attname
DISCARD ALL
DISCARD ALL
SELECT id,seq,kind,arch_type,arch_module,root_id,src,dst,undirected,props FROM anchors ORDER BY seq,id

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,

                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))
